oldRecord.name: Stamps Scholarship
oldRecord.value: Full cost-of-attendance scholarship renewable for four years (eight semesters), plus $12,000 for research and experiential learning. Storrs campus only.
oldRecord.deadline: Common App or Coalition Application by November 1, 2026. Stamps Scholarship Supplemental Application and all required documents by November 8, 2026.
oldRecord.apply: Supplemental application in the UConn applicant portal: three short answers of 100, 200 and 100 words, detailed resume and two recommendation letters. Selected applicants interview with UConn and Stamps. Early Decision Stamps results come in early February.
oldRecord.eligibility: Students graduating secondary school and entering UConn Storrs in Fall 2027, with leadership and community service. Expected GPA 3.8 on a 4.0 scale and top 10% rank if available; test optional, with expected 1420 SAT or 32 ACT if submitted. Apply to only one of Stamps, Nutmeg or Day of Pride.

newRecord.name: Stamps Scholarship
newRecord.value: Full cost-of-attendance scholarship renewable for four years (eight semesters), plus a one-time $12,000 enrichment award for research and experiential learning. Storrs campus only.

newRecord.apply: Supplemental application in the UConn applicant portal: three short answers of 100, 200 and 100 words, detailed resume and two recommendation letters. Selected applicants interview with UConn and Stamps. Early Decision Stamps results come in early February.
newRecord.eligibility: Students graduating secondary school and entering UConn Storrs in Fall 2027, with leadership and community service. Expected GPA 3.8 on a 4.0 scale and top 10% rank if available; test optional, with expected 1420 SAT or 32 ACT if submitted. Apply to only one of Stamps, Nutmeg or Day of Pride.
newRecord.notes: The listed deadline is the earlier admission requirement. Students who meet it have until November 8, 2026 to submit the Stamps supplement. Check the applicant portal for document receipt; the later supplement deadline does not extend the admission deadline.
